parameters.prompt: Create exactly ONE full-body transparent PNG game sprite, native square at least 1024x1024. Image1 is original identity, Image2 primary paint/material style, Image3 fixed same-direction standing/proportions/equipment anchor. Match all identity and detail: 08 alchemy prodigy boy, huge round head, short stout child limbs, chestnut high topknot/teal gold cap/golden ribbons, orange-gold embroidered robe with teal lapels and panels, white baggy pants, teal/gold boots. HIS RIGHT hand holds bronze/teal yin-yang cauldron, HIS LEFT hand glass green potion bottle; back herbal basket with ivory scrolls, berries, green herbs and tassels. Keep equipment and head sizes, camera, perspective, character scale, no redesign. Bright polished hand-painted chibi volume. All head, boots and equipment fit in transparent margins, character height 84% square, ground contact baseline y=92%. True transparent alpha background, no colored outline, no ground/shadow/effect/text/grid. Single walking pose, not a sheet, no extra limbs. Both legs must be newly drawn for the specified biomechanical phase. Pelvis fixed over support zone, small natural stride with no running or floating. Direction NW, back three-quarter facing upper LEFT 45 degrees away, as Image3. Walking phase 13. Anatomical LEFT NEAR leg passes the support: larger near boot is AIRBORNE under the pelvis at x48%, sole y88%, bent knee forward a little. Anatomical RIGHT FAR support boot planted slightly behind at x46%, sole y92%, partly occluded by the swinging near leg. Boots nearly aligned but one visibly lifted. No wide stride. Upper body and hand positions stay Image3: near hand screen-left green BOTTLE; far hand screen-right CAULDRON.
